description: Every covered market (about 100) with its latest called Elliott Wave count in one line, the date of the close it was made at, its invalidation price and a link to its page. Optionally limited to one group.

group.description: Optional. Only markets in this group (case-insensitive, partial match). Groups: US indices, US stocks, Sector & country ETFs, Crypto, Commodities, World indices, Rates & FX, India, China & HK, Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Europe. Omit for every market.

name: list_markets
title: List covered markets
